source: Manual seed from CRS/TCS scoping research — see notes on each record. Expanded annually by scripts/tier2_extract.py.

base_discretionary_baseline.note: Per the FY2018 wildfire funding fix (P.L. 115-141, Div. O), the 'base' suppression budget is frozen at the FY2015 10-year rolling average. This amount does not change year to year absent new legislation.
base_discretionary_baseline.source: CRS IF13102, Funding for Wildfire Management: FY2025 Appropriations for Forest Service and Department of the Interior

cap_adjustment_statutory_schedule.note: Statutory maximum combined (USFS+DOI) wildfire suppression cap adjustment available under 2 U.S.C. 901(b)(2)(F), by fiscal year. This is a ceiling set in law, not necessarily the amount enacted in a given year — see 'records' for confirmed enacted amounts.
cap_adjustment_statutory_schedule.source: Taxpayers for Common Sense, Five Fast Facts about the Wildfire Suppression Operations Reserve Fund

records.notes: FY2026 enacted at the statutory cap.
